decisions.reason: The format reader and writer plug-ins are a visible product line with their own page that extends the firm's core data integration offer, so they are likely to be maintained.
The building digital twin service fits the trend toward integrated building and geospatial data, but its low visibility on the website leaves a moderate risk of withdrawal.
The open GIS application development framework is central to the firm's open, extensible component strategy and underpins its customer projects.
After withdrawing the separate authentication service C, the GIS identity and access service likely carries the firm's identity functionality and supports enterprise integration.
The newly launched consulting workshop has its own page, needs little investment and leads into project business, so dropping it soon is unlikely.
